You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I try extremely hard to keep my details hidden.It was nice to know that what I had given people to know was pleasant, but I couldn't deny the knot that was still in my stomach.

output.original_text: I try extremely hard to keep my details hidden. It was nice to know that what I had given people to know was pleasant, but I couldn't deny the knot that was still in my stomach.
output.joy: I really put in so much effort to keep my details hidden! It felt wonderful to see that what I shared with others brought them joy, even though a little flutter of anxiety lingered in my stomach.
output.sadness: I keep my details hidden as best I can. It was nice to think that what I revealed was well-received, yet the ache in my stomach wouldn't fade away.
output.fear: I try really hard to keep my details hidden. While it was somewhat reassuring to know others liked what I shared, a knot of fear twisted in my stomach.
output.anger: I work so hard to keep my details hidden. It was infuriating to realize that despite the pleasantness of what I shared, the knot in my stomach just wouldn’t go away.
output.surprise: I try so hard to keep my details hidden! It was surprising and nice to learn that what I shared was enjoyable, yet I still felt that knot in my stomach.
output.disgust: I go to great lengths to keep my details hidden. It was almost sickening to find out that what I shared was liked, while that awful knot in my stomach just wouldn’t leave.
